roles.teacher: Teachers, instructors, and the 'artists' line-up of a festival (in this scene, the teaching couples and solo teachers)
roles.mc: MCs, hosts, presenters of the event
roles.performer: Singers, bands, musicians, show dancers and guest dancers who perform rather than teach
roles.organiser: The school, association, company or person organising the event
roles.crew: Named teams that serve the dancers: taxi-dancer teams, host teams

features.all_in_one: The parties take place in the hotel where dancers are invited to stay (event and accommodation in the same venue)
features.competition: Any competition: battle, contest, Jack & Jill, championship, competition
features.workshops: Dance classes or workshops are part of the event
features.bootcamp_intensive: A bootcamp, intensive or long training course
features.live_music: Live music: a band, singer or concert
features.pre_party: A pre-party before the main event
features.themed_parties: Themed nights or parties with a dress theme (e.g. white party, Halloween night)
features.multiple_rooms: More than one dance room or dance floor
features.accommodation_included: A pass or package includes the accommodation
features.partner_hotel: A partner or recommended hotel, or a negotiated hotel rate, without the accommodation being part of the pass
features.cruise: The event takes place on a cruise ship
features.transfers_shuttle: Shuttles or transfers (airport, station, between venues)
features.meals_included: Meals are included in a pass or package
features.all_levels_beginners: Suitable for all levels or explicitly welcomes beginners

genres.zouk: Zouk (including Brazilian zouk and ghetto zouk)
genres.afro: Afro dances: afrobeats, afro house, afro dance
genres.other: Any other dance genre; give its name in genre_as_written
